decision_rationale: Live inference unavailable locally on Windows host.

hypothesis.expected_signal: Lower average retrieval calls and preserved/improved pass rate on complex tasks.
hypothesis.hypothesis: Adaptive retrieval depth with early stopping balances localization quality against context cost.
hypothesis.observation: Fixed-depth retrieval either over-expands simple tasks or under-expands complex multi-file tasks.
hypothesis.rejection_condition: Redundant expansion loops or failure to terminate early when evidence is sufficient.
hypothesis.retrieval_change: Enable dynamic retrieval depth with evidence sufficiency checks and redundancy stops.
